answer: Consider a slashable stake pool as the Sybil barrier. Each agent must lock a bond into a shared lagoon of collateral before its vote carries any weight. Because that bond is real value, an attacker wanting k fake identities must fund k separate deposits, so the cost rises linearly with the swarm. Any duplicate caught forfeits its entire bond, which is burned, making the expected loss grow with every forged name. A velvet voice cannot replace the timber of capital underwriting each account: a thousand fake voters still need a thousand real stakes.
